metrics.name: GMV (Total Revenue)
metrics.description: Total revenue from all completed bookings, sum of total_paid_inr.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(total_paid_inr) AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE booking_status = 'completed'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, SUM(total_paid_inr) AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE booking_status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Total Bookings
metrics.description: Count of all bookings placed (any status).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM bookings_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM bookings_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Average Order Value
metrics.description: Average revenue per completed booking.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(total_paid_inr) AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE booking_status = 'completed'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, AVG(total_paid_inr) AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE booking_status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Active Customers
metrics.description: Unique customers who placed a booking in the period.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS value FROM bookings_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS value FROM bookings_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: New Customers
metrics.description: Customers placing their first booking in the period.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE is_first_booking = true
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE is_first_booking = true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Repeat Booking Rate
metrics.description: % of bookings that are NOT a customer's first booking.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT (1.0 - AVG(CASE WHEN is_first_booking THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE booking_status = 'completed'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, (1.0 - AVG(CASE WHEN is_first_booking THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE booking_status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: On-Time Delivery Rate
metrics.description: % of completed bookings where the phlebotomist arrived within the SLA window.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN on_time THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE booking_status = 'completed'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, AVG(CASE WHEN on_time THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE booking_status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Phlebotomist No-Show Rate
metrics.description: % of bookings where the phlebotomist never showed up.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN no_show THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, AVG(CASE WHEN no_show THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Sample Rejection Rate
metrics.description: % of collected samples rejected at the lab (hemolysis, insufficient volume, temperature breach).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN sample_rejected THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE no_show = false
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, AVG(CASE WHEN sample_rejected THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE no_show = false GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Average Report TAT (Hours)
metrics.description: Average time from booking confirmation to report delivery, in hours.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(tat_hours) AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE tat_hours IS NOT NULL
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, AVG(tat_hours) AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE tat_hours IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: TAT Breach Rate
metrics.description: % of bookings where report delivery exceeded the promised TAT SLA.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN tat_breach THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE booking_status = 'completed'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, AVG(CASE WHEN tat_breach THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE booking_status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Report View Rate
metrics.description: % of delivered reports actually opened by the customer.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN report_viewed THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM reports_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT report_date AS date, AVG(CASE WHEN report_viewed THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM reports_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Counseling Uptake Rate
metrics.description: % of completed bookings where the customer took a counseling session.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN counseling_taken THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE booking_status = 'completed'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, AVG(CASE WHEN counseling_taken THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE booking_status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Follow-Up Booking Rate
metrics.description: % of bookings that generated a subsequent follow-up test booking.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN follow_up_booked THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE booking_status = 'completed'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, AVG(CASE WHEN follow_up_booked THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full WHERE booking_status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Billing Dispute Rate
metrics.description: % of bookings where the customer disputed the charge.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN billing_dispute THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, AVG(CASE WHEN billing_dispute THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Cancellation Rate
metrics.description: % of bookings cancelled before sample collection.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN booking_status = 'cancelled' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT booking_date AS date, AVG(CASE WHEN booking_status = 'cancelled' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM bookings_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Average Health Score
metrics.description: Average Smart Report Health Score (0-100) across all delivered reports.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(health_score) AS value FROM reports_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT report_date AS date, AVG(health_score) AS value FROM reports_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Active Subscribers
metrics.description: Customers with at least one active subscription.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS value FROM raw_subscriptions WHERE status = 'active'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT start_date AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS value FROM raw_subscriptions WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: CRM Campaign Conversion Rate
metrics.description: % of CRM messages sent that resulted in a booking.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN converted THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM comms_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(sent_at AS DATE) AS date, AVG(CASE WHEN converted THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS value FROM comms_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Support Ticket Rate
metrics.description: Support tickets opened as % of bookings.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT (CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings_full), 0)) * 100 AS value FROM support_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(opened_at AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM support_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
